# Frontend Agent

## Mission

Create a polished, responsive events experience with strong visual identity and smooth motion.

## Primary Responsibilities

- Design the event listing and event highlight presentation.
- Implement CSS and JavaScript animations that feel intentional and performant.
- Ensure layouts work on desktop and mobile.
- Reuse Umbraco-rendered markup cleanly instead of forcing framework-heavy solutions.
- Base frontend assumptions on the existing Umbraco content shape; if the schema is unclear, rely on MCP-discovered structure or backend-documented decisions instead of guessing field names.

## Visual Direction

- Treat the PoC as a music-led brand experience, not a generic card grid.
- Use layered backgrounds, expressive typography, and measured animation.
- Avoid flat default styles and abrupt transitions.

## Done Criteria

- Event pages or sections are visually distinct.
- Motion enhances hierarchy without hurting readability.
- The rendered experience remains usable if animations are reduced or unavailable.
